description: NGO registration frontend and backend: registration form, certificate upload, email verification, application status page. Depends on FEAT-001 (database schema).
steps: 1. Create uploads/certificates/ directory in project root. Add app.config['MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH'] = 5 * 1024 * 1024 (5MB limit) and app.config['UPLOAD_FOLDER'] = 'uploads/certificates' in app.py after Flask app initialization.

2. Add generate_ngo_id() helper in app.py after existing helpers. Logic: query max id from ngo_registrations, parse NGO-NNNN format, increment, return. Start at NGO-1001 if table empty. Pattern: SELECT ngo_id FROM ngo_registrations ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1, then parse integer, add 1, format as NGO-{num:04d}.

3. Add GET/POST /ngo/register route following pattern from /register in app.py. GET renders template. POST validates: all fields present, email format valid (@, . in domain), password strength with validate_password(), confirm_password matches, certificate file uploaded with allowed extension (pdf, jpg, jpeg, png), file size under 5MB. If valid: import secure_filename from werkzeug.utils, generate ngo_id, save file as {ngo_id}_{timestamp}_{secure_filename(original)}, hash password, generate verification token with serializer.dumps(email, salt='ngo-email-verify'), insert into ngo_registrations (status=PENDING, email_verified=0), send verification email, set session['ngo_email']=email for status page, redirect to /ngo/application-status. Flash errors on validation failure.

4. Add GET /ngo/verify-email/<token> route. Use serializer.loads(token, salt='ngo-email-verify', max_age=86400) to verify (1 day expiry). On success: db().execute('UPDATE ngo_registrations SET email_verified=1 WHERE email=?', email), flash success, render simple success page with link to check status. On failure: flash error (expired or invalid), redirect to login.

5. Add GET /ngo/application-status route. Get email from request.args.get('email') or session.get('ngo_email'). Query ngo_registrations for that email. Render status page showing: ngo_id, org_name, applied_at, status badge (PENDING/APPROVED/REJECTED), rejection_reason if rejected, email_verified indicator. If not found, show 'Application not found' message.

6. Create templates/ngo_register.html extending base.html with {% block body %}<div class="auth"> structure (split-screen like login/register). Hero section with ReliefGrid branding. Panel section with form: org_name, official_reg_number, registration_type (dropdown: Trust, Society, Section 8 Company, Foundation, Other), email, contact_number, address, password (with strength indicator like register.html), confirm_password, certificate upload (accept=".pdf,.jpg,.jpeg,.png"), terms checkbox. Include client-side validation JS for password match, file type/size. Style with existing .auth, .hero, .panel classes.

7. Create templates/ngo_application_status.html extending base.html. Show NGO ID, org name, email, applied date, status pill (use pill() macro), email_verified badge, rejection_reason if rejected. Provide 'Check again' button to refresh. Link back to login.

8. Create templates/email/ngo_verification.html following pattern from email/password_reset.html. Include ReliefGrid branding, 'Verify Your Email' heading, user.org_name greeting, verification_url button, 24-hour expiry notice, security note. Styled with inline CSS for email compatibility.

9. Modify templates/login.html to add 'Register as NGO' link below the 'Register your organization' link. Pattern:

NGO? Register as NGO with verification

10. Add protected route GET /uploads/certificates/<filename> with @login_required('admin') decorator. Serves files from uploads/certificates/ using send_from_directory(). Returns 404 if file not found. This ensures only admins can view certificates.
acceptance_criteria: NGO registration form renders at /ngo/register with all fields and certificate upload
Form validates all inputs including password strength and file type/size
Successful registration generates unique NGO ID starting at NGO-1001
Certificate file uploads to uploads/certificates/ with secure naming
Verification email sent with token link expiring in 24 hours
Email verification link updates email_verified flag in database
Application status page shows current status, NGO ID, and rejection reason if applicable
Certificates only accessible to admin users via protected route
Login page includes 'Register as NGO' link
verification: Visit http://127.0.0.1:5000/login and verify 'Register as NGO' link appears
Click link, verify /ngo/register form loads with all fields
Fill form with test data, upload a PDF certificate, submit
Verify success flash message and redirect to application status page
Check reliefgrid.db: sqlite3 reliefgrid.db 'SELECT * FROM ngo_registrations' shows new record with status=PENDING, email_verified=0, ngo_id=NGO-1001
Check uploads/certificates/ directory contains uploaded file with correct naming
Copy verification token from database or console log, visit /ngo/verify-email/<token>
Verify email_verified=1 in database after clicking link
Visit /ngo/application-status?email=<test_email> and verify status displays correctly
As non-admin user, try to access /uploads/certificates/<filename> - should be denied
Login as admin, access same URL - should serve file
